items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let's see, the trumpet player, he (Goodman) was Irving.

ctx.x: Let's see, the trumpet player, he (Goodman) was Irving. / Yeah, and then the other brother was playing bass. In fact, Teddy Wilson told me that's why the trio was a trio, and not a quartet. Because they really didn't make it on bass.

Yeah, the bass player. So Lionel knew about me as he was raised here in Chicago. So he recognized me as being good, and I made that session one time, for old Victor. On Lakeshore Drive, right there at the S-curve.
